mapper.sql: select wo.outbound_id, wo.outbound_no, wo.outbound_type, wo.customer_id, mc.customer_name, wo.sale_order_id, wo.sale_order_no, wo.warehouse_id, mw.warehouse_name, wo.total_qty, wo.total_amount, wo.status, wo.audit_by, wo.audit_time, wo.reject_reason, wo.platform_type, wo.store_id, wo.source_order_no, wo.carrier, wo.waybill_no, wo.freight_cost, wo.delivery_status, wo.create_by, wo.create_time, wo.update_by, wo.update_time, wo.remark from wms_outbound wo left join md_customer mc on mc.customer_id = wo.customer_id left join md_warehouse mw on mw.warehouse_id = wo.warehouse_id left join sys_user su on su.user_name = wo.create_by and su.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select count(1) from wms_outbound where sale_order_id = #{saleOrderId} and status in ('draft', 'submitted', 'audited')
select count(1) from wms_outbound where source_order_no = #{sourceOrderNo} and status in ('draft', 'submitted', 'audited')

mapper.select: select max(outbound_no) from wms_outbound where outbound_no like concat(#{noPrefix}, '%')
mapper.update: update wms_outbound set total_qty = ifnull((select sum(quantity) from wms_outbound_item where outbound_id = #{outboundId}), 0), total_amount = ifnull((select sum(amount) from wms_outbound_item where outbound_id = #{outboundId}), 0), update_time = sysdate() where outbound_id = #{outboundId}

update wms_outbound set status = #{newStatus}, audit_by = #{auditBy}, audit_time = case when #{auditBy} is not null and #{auditBy} != '' then sysdate() else null end, reject_reason = case when #{newStatus} = 'submitted' or #{newStatus} = 'audited' then null else reject_reason end, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where outbound_id = #{outboundId} and status = #{oldStatus}

update wms_outbound set status = 'draft', reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, audit_by = null, audit_time = null, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where outbound_id = #{outboundId} and status = 'submitted'

update wms_outbound
delivery_status = #{deliveryStatus}, carrier = #{carrier}, waybill_no = #{waybillNo}, freight_cost = #{freightCost}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate()
where outbound_id = #{outboundId} and status = 'audited'
